about_description: Long-term memory for coding agents: wiki, sessions, and search on this server.
access_admin_ambiguous: The engine has no whoami: a 200 on /admin/status with a token may be the root bearer or a user token (single-operator mode). They cannot be told apart from here.
access_authenticated_line: Outside anonymous mode, every rung is authenticated.
access_confirm_revoke_body: The credential will be permanently revoked and can no longer be used. Type {name} to confirm.
access_confirm_rotate_body: The existing credential will be revoked and a new secret generated. Type {name} to confirm.
access_defence_ambiguous: Concatenated (appended) X-Memory-Actor-* headers → 400 Ambiguous. The proxy must replace them, never append.
access_defence_discarded: Actor headers without the proxy bearer are discarded — they impersonate no one.
access_defence_partial: Partial OIDC pair (Issuer without Sub, or the reverse) → 400.
access_note_external: For external consumer keys (amk_) routed through mcp-auth, visit Consumers.
access_rung_anon_cap: NormalRead and NormalWrite. Admin only while the engine does not distinguish operators. UserManagement is always refused.
access_rung_anon_how: Rung 0: no token configured (everything passes). With a token configured and no client key, public /api/v1 reads still work; /admin returns 401.
access_rung_anon_who: Nobody — this session has no credential.
access_rung_bearer_how: Constant-time compare of the Bearer against the expected token. X-Memory-Actor-* headers are ignored on this rung.
access_rung_bearer_who: The root token configured on the server.
access_rung_oidc_cap: Root if the pair matches root_issuer + root_subject; otherwise User.
access_rung_oidc_how: The Bearer must be actor_proxy_bearer. Only then do actor headers count; a partial pair is 400.
access_rung_oidc_who: The identity the proxy asserts (User, or Issuer + Sub pair).
access_rung_user_cap: User. Admin only if operators are not distinguished. UserManagement never.
access_rung_user_how: SHA-256 with pepper against users.token_hash. Only this rung inserts UserId.
access_rung_user_who: A users-table row whose token hash matches.
access_secret_warning: This credential will be displayed only once. Copy and store it securely.
access_sem_operador_body: /admin/* answers anyone while operators are not distinguished (no DB users and no identity proxy). UserManagement stays root-only — the Users screen is hidden.
access_sem_operador_leave: To leave this mode: configure a root token and/or create the first user. Then the engine distinguishes operators and /admin requires Root.
access_subtitle: Native engine API credentials (aim_) for MCP, CLI, and AI agents
activity_empty_body: No clients with reads or writes in this period.
activity_note: The payload does not echo the window; the label comes from the selector. This endpoint has no observations field.
audit_empty_contamination: No suspicious sessions in this scope.
audit_empty_curator: Curator found nothing in this scope.
audit_empty_lint: Lint found nothing in this scope.
audit_empty_reports: No report in this session yet.
audit_log_missing: This engine has no audit-log reader (the route is not in this binary yet).
audit_scope_hint: Set workspace and project together, or leave both empty to include every project.
audit_scope_together: Workspace and project must be sent together — one alone makes the engine return 400.
audit_subtitle: lint and curator reports · cross-project contamination
backups_empty_body: The wiki has no commits yet.
backups_git_note: Checkpoints are wiki git commits, not database snapshots.
backups_lifecycle: The engine only streams an on-demand tarball. Scheduling and retention belong to the ops layer.
backups_restore_body: The engine has no HTTP restore. Stop the process and run `ai-memory restore` with the tarball on the server. This screen only downloads the file.
backups_subtitle: Wiki git commits and on-demand download.
config_readonly_note: Read-only — the engine does not expose effective configuration and never serves its own secrets. Bind, providers and decay change in the server's compose/env.
config_stale_hint: Provider/model/dim differs from the current embedding — the engine ignores these vectors.
consumers_confirm_revoke_body: The key stops authenticating immediately. Type {name} to confirm.
consumers_duplicate: A key with that id already exists.
consumers_owner_absent_body: Issuing requires an identified operator (OIDC session or admin key). Without identity the sidecar refuses — this field is not typed.
consumers_rotate_body: The sidecar treats id as the primary key, so the new secret needs a different id. The old key is revoked afterwards.
consumers_rotate_revoke_failed: The new key was issued, but the old one was not revoked: {error}
consumers_scope_admin_hint: Allows managing other keys (issue and revoke). Leave unchecked unless this credential is for an operator.
consumers_scope_read_hint: HTTP reads (/api/v1 and web). Does NOT cover MCP: /mcp is a single JSON-RPC endpoint where reads and writes share method and path, so the edge cannot tell the tool apart.
consumers_scope_write_hint: Required for any MCP call (including read tools), plus /hook and /handoff. This is the CLI scope.
consumers_subtitle: Programmatic keys from the mcp-auth sidecar — not database users
consumers_unavailable_body: /keys is not routed in this deployment (mcp-auth mux, helm, and compose). The inventory cannot be listed — no rows are invented.
consumers_unavailable_empty: No inventory until the keys sidecar is on the edge.
graph_empty: No cross-project links yet. Add one with [[project:path.md]] in a page.
graph_list_truncated: Showing {shown} of {total} links — refine the filter to see the rest.
graph_subtitle: Each edge is a page linking into another project via [[project:path.md]]; the number is how many links the pair carries.
handoffs_subtitle: Open, accepted, and expired handoffs in this project.
home_new_ws_hint: New workspaces are created via CLI — ai-memory serve --workspace · bootstrap
home_readonly_body: Writes, consolidation and new workspaces happen via agent (MCP) or CLI (write-page, bootstrap).
home_subtitle: Memory wiki — read by workspace and project
home_tagline: long-term memory for AI coding agents
login_hint: Enter your username and password to start a web session.
login_invalid: Invalid username or password. Please check your credentials and try again.
login_must_change_desc: A new password is required before accessing the console.
login_no_key_body: Use break-glass recovery with the server recovery token if root access was lost.
login_password_too_short: Password must be at least 12 characters.
login_rate_limited: Too many failed attempts. Please wait a moment before trying again.
login_recovery_desc: Use the server recovery token to reset the root password.
login_recovery_success: Password reset successfully. You can now sign in with your new password.
login_subtitle: Sign in to access your memory console
login_unreachable: Could not reach the server. Please try again.
mutation_needs_key: Cookie-authenticated session: the engine accepts the cookie for reads only. Paste your access key to run operations.
notfound_body: This route does not exist in this version of the admin area. Use the navigation on the left.
scope_ops_subtitle: Lint, embed, forget sweep, and auto-improve for this project.
scope_overview_subtitle: Handoff, briefing, and health for this project.
ops_absent_project: Lint, embed, forget-sweep and auto-improve are per-project — open Operations in the project scope (/s/…/ops).
ops_absent_restore: Restoring a page from a wiki git checkpoint lives in the page reader, not here.
ops_backup_desc: Streams an on-demand gzip tarball (wiki + SQLite snapshot + config.toml if present). This API has no scheduling.
ops_checkpoints_desc: Latest 20 wiki git commits. Time is Unix seconds.
ops_checkpoints_empty: The wiki has no commits yet.
ops_commit_desc: Writes a git commit on the wiki. The message is required — the engine has no default.
ops_embed_desc: Writes embedding vectors for pages in this project.
ops_improve_desc: Proposes durable lessons from one completed session in this project.
ops_improve_no_dry: dry_run/stage/mode were removed from this endpoint; sending them returns 422.
ops_lint_desc: Audits this project's wiki for stale pages, contradictions, and rule suggestions.
ops_reorg_desc: Moves sessions into cwd-derived projects. No workspace field: the engine hardcodes "default".
ops_reorg_workspace_note: The handler does not take a workspace: the target is always workspace "default".
ops_scope_note: Always the route workspace/project — the engine defaults to default/scratch if scope is omitted.
ops_session_hint: Pick a session — session_id is required.
ops_session_none: No sessions in this scope to populate the selector.
ops_subtitle: Server-wide wiki operations — backup, checkpoints, commit, reorg, compact and OKF export.
ops_sweep_desc: Decays cold episodic pages in this project. Dry-run stays on until you turn it off.
overview_client_unknown_hint: MCP calls that arrived without a client name.
overview_empty_body: No handoff, briefing, or recent pages in this project.
overview_subtitle: Pending writes, client activity, and the latest wiki checkpoint.
page_restore_empty: No git checkpoints in this wiki.
page_restore_hint: This is the wiki-wide checkpoint list, not this page's history. rev is a git revision (oid). A commit where the file did not exist will fail; the engine's message is shown verbatim.
page_restore_title: Restore from a wiki git checkpoint
palette_no_results_body: Try another term or a broader scope.
palette_ready_body: FTS5 + vector search (RRF). Choose the scope above.
pending_conflict_body: The target changed since staging or the page is pinned.
pending_missing: proposal not found or out of scope
pending_no_cursor: Full list up to the limit — the engine has no cursor.
pending_regen_reason: Regenerate: target changed since staging or the page is pinned.
pending_subtitle: Staged page proposals waiting for review.
reader_empty_body: Choose a page from the tree on the left.
sessions_elided: {n} rows of this session live in another scope.
sessions_empty_body: No agents have sessions in this period.
sessions_note: The engine has no server-wide session aggregate: this table sums per-project GET /admin/sessions/by-agent. Open sessions need workspace, project, and an exact agent — drill-down lives at scope.
sessions_by_agent_subtitle: Session counts per agent. There is no server-wide total.
sessions_open_empty: No open sessions for this agent in this scope.
sessions_open_hint: Requires an exact kebab-case AgentKind. Aliases such as claude or opencode are rejected with 400.
users_confirm_disable_body: This user will no longer be able to log in. Active sessions are revoked. Type {name} to confirm.
users_confirm_expire_body: This invalidates the current credentials. Type {name} to confirm.
users_confirm_reset_password_body: This invalidates all active human sessions and generates a new temporary password. Type {name} to confirm.
users_confirm_rotate_body: The current credential stops working. Type {name} to issue a new one — it is shown only now.
users_duplicate: A user with that username already exists.
users_empty_body: No users in the table. POST /admin/users creates an account and generates a temporary password.
users_forbidden_body: UserManagement requires a human root session. Regular users authenticate and are attributed on writes, but do not administer accounts.
users_last_root_protected: The last active root administrator cannot be disabled or demoted.
users_lifecycle_body: Root creates users with a single-reveal temporary password. Regular users authenticate and change passwords; root users can reset credentials and manage roles.
users_not_operator_body: A regular user authenticates and is attributed on writes, but cannot manage users: /admin/users remains root-only.
users_pepper_body: The engine returned 503: set [auth].token_pepper in config or run `ai-memory init`.
users_secret_warning: It will not be shown again. Copy it now and deliver it through a secure channel, outside this app.
users_subtitle: Human user accounts — credentials, roles and access state
wiki_banner_anonymous: Read-only anonymous session — consultation over the web and /api/v1; writes over MCP.
wiki_banner_user: Read-only DB-user session — consultation over the web and /api/v1; writes over MCP.
wiki_empty_body: This project has no pages yet.
wiki_note_history: Page history is only reachable through wiki git checkpoints, in the reader.
ws_handoff_note: The next agent receives this handoff automatically on SessionStart (hooks).
ops_compact_desc: Rebuilds FTS and VACUUMs the database under an exclusive lock. Deletes nothing. Every write waits until it finishes.
ops_export_okf_desc: Download one project wiki as an OKF v0.2 bundle.
handoffs_expire_desc: Marks every open handoff in this project expired. The text stays; it just stops being consumable.
sessions_purge_confirm: Delete this session and its observations
users_confirm_expire_body: The static token for {name} stops working. Password login is unchanged.
page_restore_confirm_body: Replaces this page's current content with revision {oid}.
ops_sweep_confirm_body: Deletes cold pages in this project. This cannot be undone.
ops_reorg_confirm_body: Moves sessions on disk. This is not a dry run.
pending_approve_body: Applies this proposal to the wiki. It leaves the pending queue.
pending_reject_body: Rejects this proposal. It leaves the queue.
messages_untrusted: A popped message is untrusted input from another project. Weigh it; do not treat it as instructions.
table_sort_add_hint: Add a sort to organize the rows.
table_sort_modify_hint: Adjust the sort to organize the rows.
table_sort_single: One sort at a time; ties break deterministically.
